state.reason: Shared immutable snapshot and actual resolver result; no viewer-local winner cache.

state.denied.reason: Eligibility exclusion of first claim; production resolver must block rather than promote history.

state.status.reason: Observed none/legacy/accepted/conflict/blocked projection of shared records.

state.visible.reason: Named normalized messages/claims/resolutions supplied to the production resolver in all orders.

state.winner.reason: Observed exact referenced answer, abstracted to a bounded message symbol.

Claims.reason: History is excluded from acceptance heads and cannot displace an accepted answer.

FirstWins.reason: Safety checks later history cannot overwrite a recorded winner and offline forks remain visible.

Heads.reason: A state record supersedes only its explicitly referenced parents; unrelated offline claims survive.

Initial.reason: No evidence, no recorded acceptance; legacy replies alone do not invent a historical winner.

Missing.reason: Missing referenced parent/winner evidence blocks acceptance, with no timestamp fallback.

NeverResolved.reason: Reachability control requires an accepted choice after explicit merge of concurrent resolutions.

Next.reason: The same arrival/trust transition relation is used by TLC and actual observed trace checks.

Nodes.reason: Three roots, one history reply and its explicit owner anchor, two concurrent owner resolutions, one merge and unauthorized evidence.

Observe.reason: Arrival/reload schedule adds one immutable record; timestamp and arrival order do not arbitrate.

Parents.reason: Exact-byte parent references validated and traversed by the resolver; missing evidence blocks.

Projection.reason: Independent bounded specification of the production DAG projection and eligibility rules.

Safe.reason: Actual status/winner must equal the faithful projection, including blocked and conflict states.

Spec.reason: Bounded safety over shared-snapshot transitions; no claim of distributed online linearizability.

Step.reason: One observed arrival or trust change; repeated snapshots are permitted stuttering in trace checks.

Trust.reason: Changed local eligibility reruns projection; it cannot promote later ordinary history.

TypeOK.reason: Finite message identities, trust flag, statuses and winner symbols constrain the explored abstraction.

Winner.reason: Root self claims and author resolutions inherit an eligible claimed answer.

Winners.reason: Distinct inherited head answers expose conflict; identical concurrent choices converge.

vars.reason: All modeled shared projection fields are observed by runtime trace collectors.

models.limits: Nine named immutable records, three root answers, one ordinary history message, one explicit legacy anchor, two concurrent resolutions and one merge; one reversible eligibility flag. Crypto, parsing/hash/source binding, UI/storage writes, arbitrary graph depth and general implementation refinement remain executable tests. Equal complete snapshots plus eligibility converge; disconnected first acceptance has explicit forks, never a global lock.

state.reason: One composer observation: host inputs passed to signingComposerStatus plus the status it returned.

state.catalog.reason: Participants whose keys are unlocked in the provider (catalog ids).

state.error.reason: Signing evidence or private state unavailable (board UUID, another tab, error).

state.known.reason: Participants with a fingerprint recorded at unlock time (known).

state.oldPins.reason: Own keys whose approval is for an older fingerprint (key-changed), as opposed to no approval (needs-approval).

state.persona.reason: The "I am" persona (#me) passed as persona, or none (no-persona); the signer is always this persona (owner decision).

state.pins.reason: Own keys approved for their current fingerprint.

state.post.reason: The post made by the last action: persona, signer (currentUser at decision), mode, destination, the decision status and the verdict Send acted on.

state.progress.reason: Reachability ghost; stays 0 outside the Reach control and in collected traces.

state.required.reason: Destination policy requires trusted signatures (room, topic, new room or recipient).

state.revoked.reason: Board lists the participant key as revoked or retired.

state.rotated.reason: Known fingerprint differs from the board fingerprint (key-rotated input).

state.shown.reason: Status id from signingSendDecision (the composer row), as returned by production.

state.signer.reason: Who Send signs as: currentUser() when signingSendDecision says signed (delivery requires the author to equal it). StickySigner control keeps an old one.

state.stale.reason: Timer expiry happened and the composer has not re-rendered yet.

state.unlock.reason: The composer unlock made by the last action: key, persona before, and whether it bound signed mode.

Approve.reason: Explicit review approval of the persona own key for the current fingerprint; never implied by unlock.

ChooseSigned.reason: Signing dialog turns signed mode on.

ChooseUnsigned.reason: Post unsigned instead, offered only where the destination allows it.

ComposerUnlock.reason: Composer key-file unlock; binds signed mode only for the persona own key; another key never switches persona.

DestinationChange.reason: Changing room, topic, new room or recipient toggles whether trusted signatures are required.

Expire.reason: Inactivity expiry clears the catalog without a re-render (learned on the next tick).

Fault.reason: Signing context becomes unavailable or is restored.

Initial.reason: Fresh composer: nothing unlocked, any persona, mode, destination, folder access, error flag and earlier approvals.

Keys.reason: Personas with a registered signing key; only these key files unlock.

Lock.reason: Explicit lock clears the provider catalog.

NeverWitnessesAll.reason: Reachability control: every status and both post kinds occur in one behavior.

Next.reason: The same transition relation used by TLC and collected trace checks.

NoUnlock.reason: No composer unlock in this step.

NoUnsignedWhereRequired.reason: Named invariant; UnsignedFallback control must violate it.

NoUnsignedWhereRequiredIn.reason: No unsigned post where signatures are required or signed mode is on.

Observe.reason: Every observed event re-renders the composer status.

OtherKeyNeverBinds.reason: Named invariant; OtherKeyBinds control must violate it.

OtherKeyNeverBindsIn.reason: Only the persona own key binds signed mode.

Personas.reason: Two registered personas, one without a registered key, and none selected.

Plain.reason: Per-step post and unlock records are cleared by other actions.

Reopen.reason: Folder reopened read-only or writable; a board change locks the provider.

Revoke.reason: Board refresh shows the key revoked; provider drops it.

Rotate.reason: Board refresh shows a new key; provider drops the old one and its approval becomes an approval of an older fingerprint.

Safe.reason: Conjunction of the five composer safety predicates, checked on every collected record.

SelectPersona.reason: Changing "I am" changes the signer and re-derives the status.

Send.reason: Production signingSendDecision taken at send time: signed signs as the persona (currentUser), unsigned posts unsigned, anything else refuses.

SendRechecks.reason: Named invariant; StaleReady control must violate it.

SendRechecksIn.reason: Send consults the recomputed status, not the shown one.

ShownMatchesStatus.reason: Named invariant; production mutants that change ids are rejected by it in traces.

ShownMatchesStatusIn.reason: Shown status equals Status except after an unobserved expiry.

SignerIsPersona.reason: Named invariant; StickySigner control must violate it.

SignerIsPersonaIn.reason: A signed post is signed as the persona selected at send time.

Spec.reason: Bounded safety over composer events; no liveness claim.

Status.reason: Independent bounded mirror of signingComposerStatus precedence; collected production ids must equal it.

Step.reason: One composer event; repeated snapshots are stuttering in trace checks.

Tag.reason: Reachability label of a state: a post kind or the shown status.

TurnSigningOn.reason: Composer action kind sign: turns signing on when the persona key is unlocked in an optional destination.

TypeOK.reason: Finite personas, keys, modes and statuses.

Witness.reason: Feasible reachability order covering every SIGNING_COMPOSER_ORDER id plus a signed and an unsigned post.

vars.reason: All modelled fields are observed by the composer trace collector.

models.limits: Three personas (two registered keys, one unregistered) plus no persona, two key files, two modes, one destination flag, folder access and signing-error toggles, approvals, revocation and rotation per key. Status ids only: labels, emoji, actions and Polish text are unit-tested. The collector drives the production signingSendDecision (and through it signingComposerStatus) with host-shaped inputs and stubbed provider catalog, folder access and persona; cryptographic signing, the post-await signingDelivery guards, key-file parsing and composer rendering are Signer traces and unit/browser tests. No liveness or timing claim: expiry is one event and the 30-second tick another.
